answer: Custody of 1,000 MiB data shards requires a prism of unique registers; honest nodes pay once, but 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 times. A prism audit runs, and if an agent generates a whisper of shared memory, the verifier triggers a purge. To forge identity, agents must Whisper separate state; if leaked patterns match, assets are locked for 30 epochs. This ensures 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest node.
